correctness.rationale: For odd prime p, invertible t and unnormalized positive-sign Fourier transform on R^3=(Z/p^2)^3, the shell a²+bc=t is mod-p smooth with p² lifts per reduced point. Completing squares gives the finite-field Gauss/Salié formula; a direct D-Fourier-transform derivation checks the nonstandard Salié identity. On p-divisible frequency the lift phase is constant, giving p² times finite-field transform; for primitive frequency, tangent-plane cancellation leaves precisely the Hensel lifts r²=t(u²+4vw), with amplitude p² sum e_{p²}(r). Odd-order roots of unity rule out two-root cancellation. Count of quadratic values of the split ternary form gives B_eps=(p-1)(p²+eps p)/2 and exact rank p²+(p³+1)B_eps. Reconstructed the proof including u=v=w=0 and isotropic nonzero reduced frequency, not merely its program's exit code. Independent exact cyclotomic coefficient sums over ALL 3^6 frequencies p=3 at t=1,2 give ranks 345,177; 197 sampled p=5 frequencies for each t=1,2 match amplitude formula, explicitly not a p=5 exhaustive rank proof.
